stem: A 45-year-old male presents with a gradual rise in serum creatinine from a baseline of 1.2 mg/dL to 2.1 mg/dL at 8 months after receiving a deceased-donor kidney transplant. He has been compliant with his immunosuppressive regimen consisting of tacrolimus, mycophenolate mofetil, and prednisone. A kidney allograft biopsy is performed. Based on the timing post-transplant, which of the following is the most likely predominant histopathological finding?

options.text: T-cell mediated rejection
Antibody-mediated rejection
Calcineurin inhibitor toxicity
Recurrent glomerulonephritis

stem: A 57-year-old male is declared brain dead following a massive myocardial infarction. He had no known medical history prior to admission. His terminal serum creatinine is 1.8 mg/dL. In addition to his age and renal function, which of the following criteria must be present for him to be classified as an expanded criteria donor (ECD)?

options.text: A diagnosis of diabetes mellitus for more than 5 years
A documented history of hypertension
A terminal urine output of less than 500 mL in 24 hours
A cold ischemia time exceeding 24 hours

stem: During the procurement of organs from a donor after circulatory death (DCD), physiological parameters are closely monitored to determine the onset of functional warm ischemia time (fWIT). According to standard criteria, which of the following hemodynamic or respiratory thresholds marks the beginning of fWIT?

options.text: Systolic blood pressure drops below 90 mmHg or oxygen saturation falls below 90%
Mean arterial pressure drops below 60 mmHg or respiratory rate falls below 8 breaths per minute
Systolic blood pressure drops below 50 mmHg or oxygen saturation falls below 75%
Heart rate drops below 40 beats per minute or end-tidal CO2 falls below 15 mmHg

stem: A 45-year-old patient presents with acute kidney injury, thrombocytopenia, and microangiopathic hemolytic anemia. Renal biopsy confirms thrombotic microangiopathy (TMA). During this acute endothelial injury, which of the following changes in glomerular endothelial cell (GEnC) marker expression is typically observed?

options.text: Downregulation of Tissue Factor and upregulation of Thrombomodulin
Complete loss of CD31 expression with de novo synthesis of Nephrin
Increased expression of von Willebrand factor (vWF) and ICAM-2
Upregulation of PV-1 and loss of integrin alpha-v beta-3

stem: When distinguishing specialized glomerular endothelial cells (GEnCs) from other capillary endothelial cells in the body, researchers often analyze the expression of fenestration-associated proteins versus pan-endothelial markers. Which of the following correctly pairs a specialized fenestration-related marker with a standard pan-endothelial marker?

options.text: CD31 as a fenestration marker; VEGFR2 as a pan-endothelial marker
E-selectin as a fenestration marker; CD34 as a pan-endothelial marker
VE-cadherin as a fenestration marker; PV-1 (PLVAP) as a pan-endothelial marker
PV-1 (PLVAP) as a fenestration marker; CD31 as a pan-endothelial marker

stem: A 70-year-old male with confirmed AL amyloidosis develops progressive dyspnea and lower extremity edema. Echocardiography reveals a thickened left ventricular myocardium. Which of the following combinations of clinical and diagnostic findings is most highly characteristic of cardiac amyloidosis?

options.text: Dilated cardiomyopathy, low NT-proBNP levels, and high-voltage QRS complexes on ECG
Restrictive cardiomyopathy, significant NT-proBNP elevation, and low-voltage QRS complexes on ECG
Hypertrophic obstructive cardiomyopathy, decreased troponin levels, and normal QRS voltage on ECG
Constrictive pericarditis, normal NT-proBNP levels, and prolonged PR intervals on ECG

stem: A 6-year-old girl diagnosed with Primary Hyperoxaluria Type I (PH1) is evaluated for disease-targeted therapy. Which novel therapeutic agent works via RNA interference (RNAi) to target glycolate oxidase (HAO1 mRNA) in hepatocytes, reducing hepatic oxalate production?

options.text: Pyridoxine (Vitamin B6) alone
Potassium citrate
Cysteamine
Lumasiran
